full.description: Export or import the full Firestore site state as one JSON file — content, settings, bookings, users, and media URLs.
full.includes: Included: Firestore data (orders, users, cars, products, blogs, gallery, travel reservations, chat, branding, hero, payment settings, and more) plus image/media URLs saved in those docs.
full.exclusions: Not included: Firebase Auth passwords, binary files on Firebase Storage or ImgBB (URLs are kept so images still load after restore), and deployed app code.
